old_exact_bytes:
simp [H7, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
  rw [hS] at *
  rw [hH] at *
  linarith [h.third_history, h.third_to_sixth, h.ordered_last]
new_exact_bytes:
norm_num [H7, Finset.sum_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succ, Fin.ofNat] <;> ring
  have hhistory := h.third_history
  rw [hH] at hhistory
  rw [hS]
  linarith only [hhistory, h.third_to_sixth, h.ordered_last]
